migration.description: Introduce independent cleanup task controls without importing retired environment enablement
migration.release_unit_description: Independent retention maintenance ownership and task-only operator controls

durable_state.description: Existing archive/materialization controls, additive identity/raw cleanup controls, separate inspection/catch-up/safety retry eligibility, ownership initialization marker, durable hourly cleanup scope, and existing archive/raw correctness proofs.
durable_state.storage_implementation: SQLite maintenance store for operational controls and observations; existing business SQLite and archive/raw stores for correctness state.

ddl_structural_changes.description: Idempotently create maintenance_owner_retry_state(task_key PRIMARY KEY,failure_count,next_eligible_at,reason) in the maintenance database; no existing deployed migration is edited.

database_migration.structural_change_assessment: One additive maintenance table; no business table format changes. Existing business cleanup-state table receives an additional invocation_hour_prefixes scope before automatic admission.

dml_changes.description: INSERT OR IGNORE invocation_hour_prefixes in the existing business orphan-cleanup state table; formal cursor remains unchanged during previews.

Idempotently introduce enabled-by-default cleanup controls and their own schedules, preserving every existing task control and administrator override. Do not read, reject, or import RETENTION_ENABLED or XY_RETENTION_ENABLED.
Record completed initialization so subsequent starts and upgrades cannot reset an operator's new task choices. Only initialized task owners may be automatically admitted.

database_migration.historical_state_policy: Retain old combined history and existing correctness cursors, quarantine facts, release-pending state, and failure backoff. Do not fabricate independent historical runs or reset pending recovery.

progress_signals: Task catalog exposes four responsibility owners with effective controls.
Initialization completion is observable and idempotent.
Actual work and resource deferral are attributed to the executing owner.
Legacy history is identifiable and remains readable.
pause_points: Before automatic task admission while control initialization is incomplete.
Between bounded runs when automatic triggers are paused; explicit manual runs remain permitted.
At safe committed work boundaries for actual process shutdown or resource/budget settlement.

design_cases: New installations and newly introduced cleanup rows default to enabled.
Old RETENTION_ENABLED=false and XY_RETENTION_ENABLED values have no effect and are not imported.
Existing disabled rows and schedule overrides remain unchanged.
Repeated starts do not overwrite operator edits.
A stop during initialization safely resumes without starting duplicate owners.
Conversation references, active occupancy, hourly identity fences, raw quarantine and release-pending recovery remain valid.
Old combined records remain readable and are never split into invented task runs.
Each owner has its own completion, measurements, budget, retry state and history.
Pausing automatic triggers permits an admitted bounded run to finish and blocks later automatic rounds.
Explicit manual requests remain permitted while paused, retain single-instance admission, and do not resume automatic triggers.
An accepted manual request is not cancelled by a later automatic-trigger pause.
Task-specific CLI and dry-run scopes match their respective task ownership; preview does not advance live correctness cursors.

required_test_evidence: Declare and test durable source state from the immediately preceding Major.
Reject direct multi-Major skips or require explicit intermediate upgrades.
Verify forward repair of interrupted initialization and work.
Classify public and persistent-state impacts separately; this record contains no verified compatibility claim.

source_program_compatibility_range: Individual released sources v4.0.0 through v4.0.6 and v4.1.0 through v4.1.2; current mainline base d8aa9e7ffec8d24b499e93db633486827a87ba7c.
